services.name: Sail Times
services.desc: Skip the crowded streets, impossible parking, and packed wharves to watch the sky ignite from the tranquility of Newport Harbor. There is no better way to experience the Navy’s “Salute to Summer” than with a front-row seat on a classic sailing yacht. Enjoy breathtaking, unobstructed panoramic views of the season’s most spectacular fireworks display, surrounded by the beauty of the illuminated coastline. Step aboard as the evening cools, setting the perfect stage for a memorable night on Narragansett Bay. services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Looking for a Newport birthday party venue that no one has done before? Planning a graduation celebration or a retirement send-off that actually feels like the milestone it is? A private sailing charter in Newport puts your guests somewhere genuinely extraordinary, out on the water, surrounded by one of the prettiest harbors in the world, the sails up and the city opening up behind you. Private sailing charters are a unique and wonderful way to celebrate any special occasion.
